type: Series of portraits of emperors from various dynasties.
goal: Produce a horizontal five-panel visual flow or 5×1 grid, featuring a bust of a representative monarch from the Chinese imperial era in each panel, with inscriptions below indicating temple names or customary titles + given names, suitable for historical popularization long images or scroll-style electronic screens.

theme.dynasty: Choose one from Tang, Song, Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties

style.art_style: Meticulous heavy-color portrait bust + slight glimpse of landscape and cloud texture, feeling of silk color
style.consistency: The five images must use the same virtual court painter's brushstroke, with consistent lines and rendering strength.
style.color_palette: Low saturation earthy yellow silk background + stone blue + cinnabar red + ink

layout.format: 1x5 horizontal strip or 5 equal-width vertical panels combined
layout.background: Continuous cloud patterns and a faint background of sea cliffs, uninterrupted.

panel_design.portrait_shape: Each grid contains a bust in a rounded rectangle
panel_design.label_position: The bottom of the frame is centered.
panel_design.label_content: Respectful title or temple name customary reading + personal name, for example 'Emperor Taizong of Tang Li Shimin', 'Emperor Taizu of Song Zhao Kuangyin', 'Yuan Shizu Kublai', 'Ming Chengzu Zhu Di', 'Qing Shengzu Xuanye'

subjects.user_list: Tang: Li Shimin; Song: Zhao Kuangyin; Yuan: Kublai Khan; Ming: Zhu Di; Qing: Emperor Kangxi (Xuanye)

must_keep: Crown and vestments / tassels, etc. comply with common image records of each dynasty
Label Chinese characters must be accurate with no missing characters.
Five images should portray dignified qualities, without sarcastic expressions.
avoid: Ming and Qing official uniforms mixed, Qing emperor with no crown drawn randomly
Modern architecture appears in the background
